title: Create a visual timeline of the boot process
summary: Generate an SVG file that shows when each system service started and how long it took. This provides a graphical view of the boot sequence.

steps.explain: Create an SVG file showing the boot timeline. Replace <FILE> with your desired output path.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the output SVG file

steps.expect: An SVG file is created in the specified location.
